docs.title: Nmap Cheatsheet
docs.text: Flags & Options Practical Examples Scan Types Scan-sSSYN scan (stealth) — sends SYN, does not complete the handshake. Faster and stealthy. Scan-sTTCP connect scan — completes full handshake. Used without root privileges. Scan-sUUDP scan — detects UDP services (DNS, SNMP, DHCP...). Scan-sN / -sF / -sXNull, FIN, and Xmas scan — evades some firewalls, ambiguous behavior on Windows. Scan-sAACK scan — detects firewall rules rather than open ports. Scan-sVService version detection on open ports. Scan-OOperating system detection via TCP/IP fingerprinting. Scan-AAggressive mode: OS detection, versioning, scripts, and traceroute all at once. Host Discovery & Ports Host/Port-p <ports>Defines which ports to scan. Ex: -p 80,443 / -p 1-1000 Host/Port-p-Scans all 65,535 ports. Host/Port--top-ports NScans the top N most common ports. Host/Port-snPing scan — only discovers hosts without scanning ports. Host/Port-PnSkip host discovery — treats all targets as online. Host/Port-PRARP ping — host discovery on local networks, highly reliable. Host/Port--openShows only open ports in the output. Host/Port-iL <file>Reads target list from a text file. Timing & Performance Timing-T0 ... -T5Scan speed. T0=paranoid (stealthy), T3=normal, T5=insane. Timing--min-rate NForces a minimum of N packets sent per second. Timing--max-retries NLimits retries per port (useful to speed up scans). Timing--host-timeoutAbandons a host if it takes longer than X time. Ex: 30s Nmap Scripting Engine (NSE) NSE-sCRuns default NSE scripts (equivalent to --script=default). NSE--script=<name>Runs a specific script. Ex: --script=vuln NSE--script-argsPasses arguments to scripts. Ex: user=admin NSE--script-helpShows help for a specific script. Evasion & Spoofing Evasion-fFragments packets to evade IDS/IPS. Evasion-D <decoys>Decoy scan — mixes your IP with decoy IPs to confuse logs. Evasion--source-port NForces the source port. Firewalls often trust ports 53 or 80. Evasion--scan-delayAdds a delay between probes to avoid rate-limiting alerts. Output Formats Output-oN <file>Saves output in normal (readable) format. Output-oX <file>Saves in XML format — compatible with Metasploit. Output-oG <file>Grepable format — easy to parse with grep/awk. Output-oA <base>Saves in all three formats simultaneously. Host Discovery / Local Network Recon root@kali:~#nmap -sn 192.168.1.0/24copy root@kali:~#nmap -sn -PR 192.168.1.0/24copy Discovers active hosts without scanning ports. -PR uses ARP (highly reliable on LAN). Ideal for the initial phase of an internal pentest. Fast Port Scanning Basic root@kali:~#nmap -sS -T4 --top-ports 1000 -Pn 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -sS -p- --min-rate 5000 -Pn -n 10.10.10.5copy The second command scans all 65,535 ports at high speed. -n disables DNS resolution for faster execution. Heavily used in CTFs and HTB labs. Version & OS Detection Basic root@kali:~#nmap -sV -O -sC 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -A -p 22,80,443,8080 10.10.10.5copy -sV fingerprints the service, -O detects the OS, -sC runs default scripts. -A bundles everything. Essential step after the initial port scan. SMB Enumeration NSE root@kali:~#nmap -p 139,445 --script=smb-os-discovery 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -p 139,445 --script=smb-enum-shares,smb-enum-users 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -p 445 --script=smb-vuln-ms17-010 10.10.10.5copy Detects SMB version, available shares, users, and critical vulnerabilities like EternalBlue (MS17-010). Mandatory in Windows/Active Directory environments. HTTP / Web Enumeration NSE root@kali:~#nmap -p 80,443,8080 --script=http-title,http-headers 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -p 80 --script=http-enum 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -p 80 --script=http-methods 10.10.10.5copy http-enum performs common path fuzzing (similar to a basic gobuster). http-methods detects dangerous HTTP verbs (PUT, DELETE). Database Enumeration NSE # MySQLroot@kali:~#nmap -p 3306 --script=mysql-info,mysql-empty-password 10.10.10.5copy # MS-SQLroot@kali:~#nmap -p 1433 --script=ms-sql-info,ms-sql-empty-password 10.10.10.5copy Checks for basic database information and attempts to find accounts with blank passwords. FTP / SSH / RDP NSE root@kali:~#nmap -p 21 --script=ftp-anon,ftp-bounce 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -p 22 --script=ssh-auth-methods 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -p 3389 --script=rdp-vuln-ms12-020 10.10.10.5copy ftp-anon detects if the FTP server allows anonymous login. rdp-vuln checks for a critical DoS/RCE vulnerability. Vulnerability Scanning Vulns root@kali:~#nmap -sV --script=vuln 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -sV --script=exploit 10.10.10.5 --script-args=unsafe=1copy The vuln category runs all CVE detection scripts. The unsafe=1 argument enables potentially intrusive scripts — use only in controlled environments. UDP Scan UDP root@kali:~#nmap -sU -p 53,67,68,161,500 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -sU -p 161 --script=snmp-info 10.10.10.5copy UDP scanning is slow — limit the target ports or use --top-ports. SNMP (161) often reveals critical network/system info. Firewall / IDS Evasion Evasion root@kali:~#nmap -sS -f -T2 --data-length 200 -D RND:10 10.10.10.5copy root@kali:~#nmap -sS --source-port 53 -Pn 10.10.10.5copy -f fragments packets, -D RND:10 generates 10 random decoy IPs, --source-port 53 mimics DNS traffic. Combining techniques increases evasion success. Full Workflow (CTF / Pentest) Workflow # Phase 1: Fast all-ports discoveryroot@kali:~#nmap -sS -p- --min-rate 5000 -Pn -n -oN ports.txt 10.10.10.5copy # Phase 2: Deep dive into open portsroot@kali:~#nmap -sV -sC -O -p 22,80,445 -oA full_scan 10.10.10.5copy # Phase 3: Targeted scripts based on findingsroot@kali:~#nmap -p 445 --script=smb-vuln-ms17-010 10.10.10.5copy Standard methodology: speed → depth → targeted scripts. Always save your output using -oA or -oN for later review.
